title: Define and prove colour and surface semantics
objective: Create a canonical semantic colour and surface system that works across light, dark, email, document and print contexts while keeping approved product gradients as identity objects rather than decoration.

included: semantic neutrals, surfaces, text, borders, feedback, focus and disabled roles
light and dark behaviours plus email-safe, document-safe and print-safe mappings
contrast, state, forced-colour and failure fixtures
generated tokens, schema, guidance and a bounded human surface-character proof
excluded: changing approved source gradients or Living Core rendering

acceptance: one semantic source generates channel-safe tokens
contrast and state rules are mechanically verifiable
gradient authority remains separate and unchanged
light, dark, email, document, print and failure fixtures are visible
the proof isolates monochrome and surface character
human verdict can be recorded without changing unrelated foundations

verification.passCondition: source, generated tokens and task records validate
required text, control, feedback and focus pairings meet the declared contrast contract
light, dark, email, document and print fixtures preserve hierarchy and state meaning
Olli approves the monochrome and surface character

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Should final-lock-02 be canonical: F8F8F8 canvas, inherited Mez identity, neutral routine feedback, contained dark and explicit channel mappings?

stopConditions: a semantic role cannot meet its declared contrast or state requirement
the work changes approved source-gradient or Living Core authority
channel mappings require silent colour substitutions
the proof combines product-expression or homepage decisions with the foundation gate
notes: The read-only audit preserved the historical light-monochrome ladder, constrained dark to contained inverse rooms, and treated blue and status hues as functional signals only.
The canonical final-lock-02 foundation contains 39 primitives, 43 semantic roles across five explicit modes, 85 passing contrast checks and a self-contained generated package.
Mez Systems inherits the parent F8F8F8 canvas and 2E2E2E Wings; it adds no separate corporate hue. Routine feedback stays neutral and reserves tint for critical emphasis.
Olli approved H-FND-02-SURFACE-PROOF at 2026-07-21T08:19:31.000Z; DEC-COLOUR-FOUNDATION-001 and brand-kit/foundations/colour/review.json make final-lock-02 canonical.
Gradient registry, Living Core palettes, product expressions and the active migration release remain unchanged.
